automations.name: [factory:intake]
automations.prompt: Save the trigger payload (the <trigger_event> JSON) to a file. Run `uv run factory/gate.py check --node intake --event <file>`; on exit 10 stop and report why. Otherwise read `role_file` and every skill it lists, and do the role's work on the `branch` of the output (create it from the default branch when it does not exist; the platform pushes). Write the role's handoff to `handoff_path`, then run `uv run factory/gate.py apply --node intake --event <file> --handoff <handoff_path>`.
